command.description: The command that regenerates the output, run by Bash at the repository's root.

items.description: A path from the repository's root, or a directory and everything under it with a trailing `/**`. `*` is allowed only in that suffix, and no segment may be empty, `.`, or `..`.

paths.description: The generated output: the only paths the bot commits. None may match anything under `.github/workflows/`, which the bot cannot write, so `.github/**` is refused too.

setup.description: Commands that install the generators, run by Bash before `command`. `~/.local/bin` is on the PATH.

setupTimeout.description: How long each setup command may run, in seconds. `timeout` and `setupTimeout` for each setup command may total at most 480.

timeout.description: How long `command` may run, in seconds. `timeout` and `setupTimeout` for each setup command may total at most 480.

items.description: A path from the repository's root, or a directory and everything under it with a trailing `/**`. `*` is allowed only in that suffix, and no segment may be empty, `.`, or `..`.

triggers.description: The files whose change by Renovate calls for a regeneration.

workflowEnv.description: The path from the repository's root of a workflow whose top-level `env` block, at the pull request's head, is passed to `setup` and `command`, so the generators are the versions CI verifies the output with.

description: How Chachamaru regenerates a repository's generated output on a Renovate pull request, read from `.chachamaru/regenerate.yml` on the base branch.
title: Chachamaru regeneration
